title: The Organ That Regrows
hook: Your body has one organ that can grow itself back from nothing.
script: Your body hides a secret organ capable of regenerating itself from nearly nothing. What happens when you carve away a massive piece of your liver? The result is a biological miracle that defies everything we know about healing. Even after donating 65 percent, both pieces regrow to nearly full size in 8 to 10 weeks. It is like a house doubling its entire square footage without adding a foundation. This isn't just stem cells; mature cells simply wake up and start replicating. One liver can be split between two people and grow independently to support both. It is the only solid organ that regrows working tissue instead of just scarring over. We still cannot explain the invisible sensor that tells the growth exactly when to stop.
